code2='''def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid); sep=grid[0][4]
    rowseps=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x==sep for x in row)]
    colseps=[j for j in range(n) if all(grid[i][j]==sep for i in range(n))]
    def bands(seps):
        out=[]; a=0
        for x in seps+[n]:
            if a<x: out.append((a,x))
            a=x+1
        return out
    rb=bands(rowseps); cb=bands(colseps)
    cells=[]
    for ri,(ra,rz) in enumerate(rb):
        for ci,(ca,cz) in enumerate(cb):
            vals=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(ca,cz)] for r in range(ra,rz)]
            count=sum(v!=0 and v!=sep for row in vals for v in row)
            if ci>0 and count: cells.append((count,ri,ci,vals))
    _,_,_,motif=max(cells)
    colors=[]
    for ra,rz in rb:
        colors.append(next((grid[r][c] for r in range(ra,rz) for c in range(1,min(3,n)) if grid[r][c] not in (0,sep)),0))
    out=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in rowseps:
        out[r]=[sep]*n
    for c in colseps:
        for r in range(n): out[r][c]=sep
    for ri,(ra,rz) in enumerate(rb):
        for ca,cz in cb:
            for i in range(rz-ra):
                for j in range(cz-ca):
                    if i<len(motif) and j<len(motif[i]) and motif[i][j] not in (0,sep): out[ra+i][ca+j]=colors[ri]
    return out
'''
